abstract: Several theories have been postulated regarding the origin of ovarian teratomas, including incomplete twinning, neoplastic proliferation of sequestered totipotent blastomeres or primordial cells, derepression of totipotent genetic information in the nuclei of somatic cells, and parthenogenetic development of germ cells. At present parthenogenetic development of ova is the most widely accepted theory, primarily because of the presence of a 46 XX karyotype in almost all mature teratomas. However, some authors have raised the possibility of fusion of ova in the mechanism of formation of ovarian teratomas. We report the results of a study on ovarian tissue adjacent to 31 teratomas to assess the frequency of biovularity, which could provide evidence favoring the last theory. On the whole we found biovularity in 26 ovaries of young patients (mean age, 27 years) with variable numbers of biovular follicles ranging from 1 in 4 cases to more than 10 in 2 cases; the number of biovular follicles depended on the quantity of ovarian tissue examined as well as on the total number of ova in the tissue. In multiple occasions 2 ova were included within a single follicle; in 24 ovaries the biovularity was correlated with coalescence of primary follicles characterized morphologically by an ovoid or hourglass-like shape that resulted from cohesion of 2 follicles. As control cases, 30 ovaries of patients with an average age of 28 years were examined (12 removed for endometriosis, 8 for serous cystadenoma, 7 for tubal pregnancy, and 3 for acute salpingo-oophoritis). Only 1 ovary with endometriosis contained a single biovular follicle. The results suggest that ovarian teratoma development may result from fusion of ova in ovaries containing biovularity and phenomena of coalescence of primary follicles.
abstract_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の成因としていくつかの説が提唱されている。すなわち、不完全双生、隔離された全能性割球または原始細胞の腫瘍性増殖、体細胞核における全能性遺伝情報の脱抑制、卵子の単為発生などである。成熟奇形腫のほぼすべてが46,XX核型を示すことから、現在は卵子の単為発生が最も広く受け入れられている。しかし、卵子の融合が卵巣奇形腫の形成機序である可能性を指摘する研究者もいる。我々は、31例の奇形腫に隣接する卵巣組織を調べ、後者の説を支持する証拠となりうる双卵性の頻度を評価した。若年患者（平均27歳）の26例の卵巣で双卵性を認めた。双卵性卵胞の数は、4例では1個、2例では10個を超え、検討した卵巣組織の量と卵子の総数に依存した。複数の場合で、2個の卵子が1つの卵胞内に含まれていた。24例の卵巣では、双卵性は原始卵胞の癒合と関連していた。原始卵胞の癒合は、2つの卵胞が結合して生じる卵円形または砂時計様の形態で特徴づけられた。対照群として、平均年齢28歳の患者の卵巣30例を検討した（子宮内膜症で12例、漿液性嚢腫で8例、卵管妊娠で7例、急性卵管卵巣炎で3例）。子宮内膜症の卵巣のうち1例のみに単一の双卵性卵胞が認められた。結果は、卵子の融合を含む双卵性と原始卵胞の癒合が認められる卵巣で卵巣奇形腫が形成される可能性を示唆する。
